subject: planner: eliminate outer join on nullable unique keys under EQ (#65843)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. The change correctly treats inner-side nullable unique keys as sufficient for outer-join elimination under `=` (NULL join keys never match, so nullable-UK null-duplicates cannot create multi-match), while explicitly preventing this optimization when the join key uses NullEQ (`<=>`) on nullable columns (where NULLs can match and multi-match is possible). Both the non-cascades rule (`pkg/planner/core/rule_join_elimination.go`) and cascades transformation (`pkg/planner/cascades/old/transformation_rules.go`) apply the same guard, and `pkg/planner/core/casetest/plan_test.go` adds coverage for the `<=>` cases. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; no follow-up fixes specific to this nullable-UK/NullEQ logic were found.
